name: hide the secret as the constant term of a random polynomial and hand out evaluations
mechanism: choose a random polynomial of degree one less than the threshold, with the secret as its constant term; give each holder one evaluation point; any threshold-many points determine the polynomial and so the secret, while fewer leave every value equally likely

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Shamir's secret sharing' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

requires: arithmetic in a field larger than the secret
fails_when: a dishonest holder can submit a false share undetected without an extra check
